newsitem.title: BOSNIA: First tranche of U.S. heavy weapons arrive.
newsitem.headline: First tranche of U.S. heavy weapons arrive.

text.p: The first tranche of U.S. heavy weapons being supplied to Bosnia's Moslem-Croat Federation army arrived on Bosnian territory on Thursday, witnesses said.

One tank and 10 armoured personnel carriers arrived by rail in Hadzici, west of Sarajevo, as part of a U.S.-sponsored "equip and train" programme intended to bring Federation forces up to military parity with Bosnian Serb rivals.
The United States is spending about $100 million on the programme. Islamic countries are contributing another $300 million in training and equipment.

A ship carrying U.S. tanks, armoured personnel carriers, tens of thousands of assault rifles and tonnes of ammunition was kept idling in the Adriatic for weeks until Sarajevo finally agreed to dump a defence minister with ties to Iran.
NATO-led peace forces are monitoring the weapons deliveries closely to ensure the equipment goes only to cantonment sites approved under the Dayton peace process.
